name: WooCommerce
notes: Keeps WooCommerce from sending usage data and error logs to WooCommerce.com, stops marketplace suggestions and promoted extensions in the admin, and turns off Order attribution, which loads a tracking script and sets cookies for every visitor to record where orders came from. Turn Order attribution back on (WooCommerce › Settings › Advanced › Features) if you use it. Turns on Deferred emails so checkout does not wait for the mail server. Emails go out when Action Scheduler runs, which needs WP-Cron or a server cron. If order emails arrive late or not at all, check WooCommerce › Status › Scheduled Actions (group woocommerce-emails) for pending or failed woocommerce_send_queued_transactional_email actions, and turn Deferred emails off in WooCommerce › Settings › Advanced › Features.

woocommerce_allow_tracking.label: Enable tracking
woocommerce_allow_tracking.description: Sends WooCommerce usage data to WooCommerce.

woocommerce_feature_remote_logging_enabl.label: Remote Logging
woocommerce_feature_remote_logging_enabl.description: Sends error logs and diagnostic data to WooCommerce.

woocommerce_show_marketplace_suggestions.label: Show Suggestions
woocommerce_show_marketplace_suggestions.description: Suggestions for extensions from WooCommerce.com, inside WooCommerce.

woocommerce_feature_order_attribution_en.label: Order Attribution
woocommerce_feature_order_attribution_en.description: Tracks which channels and campaigns lead to orders.

woocommerce_feature_deferred_transaction.label: Deferred emails
woocommerce_feature_deferred_transaction.description: Sends order emails through Action Scheduler after checkout, so the customer does not wait for the mail server.
